prompt: The camera does not move. A painted 1930s chapter card comes to life. The dealer in the fedora slides the two envelopes slowly across the polished counter towards us and fans them a little apart with his fingertips, then lifts his eyes with a slow, sly smile. The lamp's warm glow gently breathes on the wood. The painted lettering of the title band stays crisp and still. The picture keeps its flat painted 1930s poster look, brushstrokes and grain. One continuous shot, no cuts, no dialogue. The camera does not move. Thanks.
